title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch With Integrated Towel Bar Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a wall mount glass shelf that adds a 16 x 5 inch surface and an integrated towel bar in one streamlined piece.

  • Space-saving install: wall-mounted design helps keep counters clearer
  • Built-in towel storage: integrated towel bar keeps a hand towel within reach
  • Strong glass: 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with a beveled edge
  • Solid brass hardware: crafted from solid brass materials for durable support
  • Coordinated look: part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 Inches
  • Projection: 5 Inches
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware (screw size #8 x 1 1/4")
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available

_previous.title: Waverly Place 16 Inch Glass Vanity Shelf with Integrated Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add space and organization to your bathroom with this simple, traditional style glass shelf. Featuring tempered, beveled-edged glass and solid brass hardware this shelf is crafted for durability, strength and style. One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass Waverly Place Collection, this subtle glass shelf is the perfect complement to your bathroom décor.
